On this walk you study late Mughal funerary architecture and the garden setting.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Main gate
  • Garden quadrants
  • Tomb plinth
  • Exit interpretation

How the time is spent

  1. Main gate 20 min

    Explain late-Mughal political context and axial entry.

    You: locate axes

  2. Garden quadrants 35 min

    Discuss charbagh adaptation and landscape change.

    You: sketch plan

  3. Tomb plinth 30 min

    Inspect marble/sandstone contrast.

    You: record materials

  4. Exit interpretation 20 min

    Discuss patronage, maintenance and colonial histories.

    You: compare Humayun template

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Identify and interpret key features of Safdarjung’s Tomb using material evidence and a site map.
  • Study late Mughal funerary architecture and the garden setting.
  • Distinguish directly visible fabric from reconstructed or debated historical claims.

You take away

Your annotated field card, sketches and notes.

Where
Lodhi Road, Delhi
For
Schools, colleges, the public and private groups
Length
1.5 to 2 hours
When
Any day you choose. Early morning is best in the warmer months.
Led by

Language
English, Hindi or both. Other languages on request, through our partners.
Group size
Agreed with you. Smaller and larger groups are welcome.
Meeting point
Agreed with you. A map location is shared once the date is confirmed.
What to bring
Comfortable shoes, water and a hat. The ground is uneven in places.
Entry fees
Monument entry fees, where charged, are not included.
Price
From ₹9,000 per group, including GST
